 Ross County midfielder scores his first goals for Malaysia in friendly victory
 By Will Clark - will.clark@hnmedia.co.uk Published: 11:11, 17 November 2026 Richard Chin in action for Ross County. Picture: Ken Macpherson Richard Chin was on target for his country as he scored twice for Malaysia in their 2-1 victory over Yemen in a friendly this morning.
 The defensive midfielder found the net in Malaysia’s victory over Yemen at the Zhaoqing New District Sports Centre in China on Tuesday morning.
 Chin (24) opened the scoring after just seven minutes with a fierce volley just inside the penalty box.
 He doubled Malaysia’s advantage in the 57th minute after he pounced on a loose ball caused by a misunderstanding between Yemen’s goalkeeper and defender.
 Yemen did pull one with 13 minutes remaining, but Malaysia held on for victory.
 It was the first game that Chin, who won his third international cap, had scored for Malaysia.
 Chin arrived at Ross County in June from Raith Rovers for an undisclosed fee. 
 He started his career at Charlton Athletic and also played at Dartford, Bath City and Farnborough before moving to Scotland.
 Defender Dylan Smith was also called up for international duty as he was named in the Scotland Under-21 squad for friendlies against Ukraine and the United States. 
 He started in the 4-0 against Ukraine and in the 1-1 draw with the United States.
